onboarding.title: Welcome to Air Track 🌿
onboarding.description: Track air quality in real time and stay informed about pollution levels around you. Discover the Air Quality Index (AQI) and make informed decisions for a healthier environment.

onboarding.title: Enable Location 📍
onboarding.description: Allow location access to check air pollution levels in your area. Get local AQI updates and stay informed about the air quality around you.

onboarding.title: Understand  Air Quality 🌿
onboarding.description: Check the Air Quality Index (AQI) to understand pollution levels in your area. Learn whether the air is good, moderate, or poor and take steps to protect your health and the environment.
